name: Statuspage
whatYouLose: Hosting the status page on infrastructure separate from your own (do this anyway)
prompt:
Build a public status page, an Atlassian Statuspage replacement.

Stack: Astro static site rebuilt by a GitHub Action; incidents as markdown files in the repo.
Features:
- Components (API, Web, Database) with current status and 90-day uptime bars.
- A scheduled GitHub Action pings each component URL every 5 minutes and commits results to a JSON history file.
- Incidents and maintenance windows as markdown with frontmatter (status, affected components, updates timeline).
- RSS/Atom feed and email subscriptions via a provider webhook.
- Deploys to GitHub Pages, so it stays up even when your infrastructure does not.
Done when: taking a test URL down shows a red bar and an open incident on the page within 10 minutes.
notes: Static site + scheduled checks. Hosting it on a different provider than your app is the only real requirement.
